title: Orphan quality control by an SCF ubiquitin ligase directed to pervasive C-degrons
authors: Kong KE; Shankar S; Rühle F; Khmelinskii A
one_liner_zh: 该文系统鉴定酵母C-degron并揭示SCF泛素连接酶Das1识别多种C端降解子，涉及短线性基序介导的蛋白互作识别，但对象非无序蛋白/相分离，方法含机器学习但非AI/物理模拟建模，机制深度有限。
abstract:
Summary

Selective protein degradation typically involves substrate recognition via short linear motifs known as degrons. Various degrons can be found at protein termini from bacteria to mammals. While N-degrons have been extensively studied, our understanding of C-degrons is still limited. Towards a comprehensive understanding of eukaryotic C-degron pathways, we performed an unbiased survey of C-degrons in budding yeast. We identified over 5000 potential C-degrons by stability profiling of random peptide libraries and of the yeast C-terminome. Combining machine learning, high-throughput mutagenesis and genetic screens revealed that the SCF ubiquitin ligase targets ∼40% of degrons using a single F-box substrate receptor Das1. Although sequence-specific, Das1 is highly promiscuous, recognizing a variety of C-degron motifs. By screening for endogenous substrates, we implicate SCF Das1 in degradation of orphan protein complex subunits. Altogether, this work provides a comprehensive view of a eukaryotic C-degronome and uncovers how an SCF/C-degron pathway of broad specificity contributes to proteostasis.
abstract_zh:
摘要

选择性蛋白质降解通常涉及通过称为降解决定子（degrons）的短线性基序进行底物识别。从细菌到哺乳动物，蛋白质末端可发现多种降解决定子。虽然N-降解决定子已被广泛研究，但我们对C-降解决定子的理解仍然有限。为了全面理解真核生物C-降解决定子通路，我们对芽殖酵母中的C-降解决定子进行了无偏调查。通过随机肽库和酵母C末端组的稳定性分析，我们鉴定了超过5000个潜在的C-降解决定子。结合机器学习、高通量突变和遗传筛选，揭示了SCF泛素连接酶通过单一F-box底物受体Das1靶向约40%的降解决定子。尽管具有序列特异性，Das1高度混杂，识别多种C-降解决定子基序。通过筛选内源性底物，我们暗示SCF Das1参与孤儿蛋白复合物亚基的降解。总体而言，这项工作提供了真核生物C-降解决定子组的全面视图，并揭示了广谱特异性的SCF/C-降解决定子通路如何促进蛋白质稳态。
